title: Director of Quality
text:
Job Title: Director of Quality
 Employment Status: Full-time
 Office Hours: Monday - Friday; hybrid schedule
 Location: Boston, Massachusetts
 Compensation: $150,000 - $185,000, plus equity options. (Compensation dependent on experience level)

 
 The Director of Quality owns Ketryx's Quality Management System (QMS), Information Security Management System (ISMS), AI governance program, and certification portfolio. This leader keeps our processes effective, scalable, and audit-ready while helping the business ship and serve enterprise customers efficiently. Because Ketryx builds compliance software for regulated industries, the role is also an internal reference user of our platform and a public voice on quality and regulatory practice.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Own the QMS and support the ISMS: Keep policies, SOPs, and records aligned with how we operate, including ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 programs.

 Lead AI governance: Own AI policies and ISO/IEC 42001 conformity, and set assurance expectations for validated AI agents.

 Run audits and certifications: Lead readiness and execution for ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, IEC 61508, and ISO 26262, plus customer audits and supplier assessments.

 Govern change and release: Define risk-based gates and evidence expectations, and own release-level risk assessments.

 Enable customers and deals: Maintain validation packages and the trust center, and support questionnaires, RFPs, and strategic accounts where compliance is a blocker.

 Track regulation: Monitor emerging requirements (e.g., EU MDR, EU Cyber Resilience Act, 21 CFR Part 11) and translate them into internal and customer guidance.

 Lead the QA/RA consulting team: Staff engagements, set deliverable standards, provide final review, and develop consultants.

 Partner across the company: Work with Engineering, Product, Security, Sales, and leadership, and represent Ketryx externally through content, conferences, and standards work.

 
 How Success Is Measured 

 
 Zero major nonconformities in certification audits, with findings closed on time

 All committed certifications achieved or maintained, including ISO 26262 by August 2027

 Validation packages and risk assessments published for every platform release

 Fast, reliable responses to customer compliance inquiries and deal blockers

 High-quality consulting deliverables with zero quality-related escalations

 
 What We're Looking For 

 
 10+ years of experience in quality at a MedTech, BioPharma, or Life Sciences company

 Track record operating or leading a QMS and supporting external audits in a regulated environment

 Experience owning or materially supporting an ISMS under ISO/IEC 27001 or equivalent

 Strong command of risk-based quality practices and change and release governance

 Clear communicator with technical and non-technical audiences, with strong documentation skills

 
 Nice to Have 

 
 Hands-on audit experience across ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO/IEC 42001, IEC 61508, ISO 26262, and SOC 2

 Experience with AI governance and validating AI-enabled features

 Background supporting customer validation and security questionnaires for enterprise SaaS

 Familiarity with functional safety tool qualification

 Experience leading a team of quality or regulatory professionals

 What We Offer

 
 Competitive compensation

 Generous stock options possible

 Work in an exciting field with a positive impact on the world

 Opportunity to learn and grow as part of a global team

 Generous PTO for full-time

 
 Ketryx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances

 Ketryx is saving and improving lives by making medical software safe and reliable. We empower software teams building medical applications to create safe, secure, and compliant products used by patients and providers worldwide. We believe that, by automating much of the documentation and quality processes, teams will be able to produce safer and more innovative medical software faster.

 Ketryx is at the forefront of helping teams incorporate AI/ML into medical software and that’s why we need you!
